subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**safeguard**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage discusses the importance of measures to protect against forest fires.
 
• The appropriate word should indicate an action or measure that provides protection.
 
• "**Safeguard**" fits well as it denotes a measure taken to protect against potential harm, which aligns with the context of forest fire prevention.
 
• Other options ("**safeguards**", "**safeguarded**", "**safeness**") do not fit the context as precisely as "safeguard".

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.
